name: Nitsan Portfolio
description: Personal portfolio website — Digital Craftsman landing page with interactive bento grid, particle effects, and carousel

commands.dev: open index.html (or VS Code Live Server on port 5500)

architecture.notes: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS portfolio with no build step. Features: glitch text effect, interactive blob, bento grid layout, skill carousel, particle background, custom cursor, scroll-triggered animations, marquee ticker. Google Fonts: Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono.
